requirement.summary: [Bug fix] The general user does not have the System Configuration module
requirement.description:
Steps To Reproduce:

- Use the general user login system

- Go to System Management -> System Configuration

Actual result :

- The system does not display the "System Configuration" module

Expected result:

- Authorized general users are able to use the System Configuration module

# <<< 1.2.117.0 >>>
Bug Fixing: [Jira-70047] [Bug fix] The general user does not have the System Configuration module
Description:
Fixed the issue where the system configuration navigation was not displayed for regular users.
Setup:
When a regular user logs into the system, if the "System Configuration" navigation is not hidden in the "Function Permission Filter" feature, then it should be displayed.
If the update fails to display after retrieving it, please try performing the "Clear Cache" operation in "Infrasys POS System Tools" and then log back into your account.
